pageDescription: One question a day, the same for everyone. Answer in a few seconds and come back tomorrow.
noneText: Come back soon: a new question will appear as soon as the team has prepared one.
needScript: This game needs JavaScript to answer. Turn it on in your browser, then reload the page.
otherLanguage: This question does not exist in your language yet: it is shown in {lang}.
timerLabel: Timer ({n} s): bonus points if I answer fast
timerHelp: The timer is only a bonus: you can take all the time you need, or untick it.
timerOn: The speed bonus goes down little by little, with no penalty.
timerOff: Timer off: no speed bonus, and no penalty.
timerEnd: The speed bonus is over. Take your time, there is no penalty.
comeBack: Come back tomorrow for a new question.
hintText: Today's game is waiting for you!
copyFail: Could not copy automatically: the text is selected, copy it by hand.
newDay: A new question has arrived. The page will reload.
limit: Too many tries for now. Please try again a bit later.
invalid: This answer could not be read. Reload the page and try again.
busy: The game is very busy right now. Try again in a moment.
net: The connection failed. Check your network and try again: your answer is not lost.
privacyShort: Your streak and scores stay in this browser: no account, no cookie, nothing is sent to the site.
noStorage: Your browser does not keep the streak (storage blocked): the game works, but the streak will not be remembered.
clearData: Erase my data for this game
cleared: Done: your streak and scores have been erased from this browser.
cardToPlay: A new question is waiting for you today.
cardPlayed: Already played today. Come back tomorrow!
boardEmpty: Nobody is on the ranking yet this week.
boardAsk: Do you want to appear on this week's ranking, with a nickname?
boardPseudoHelp: Visible to everyone. No real name needed. Example: Fox2000.
boardManage: Change nickname or leave the ranking
boardNeedPseudo: Write a nickname, for example Fox2000.
boardAlready: You appear on the ranking as “{n}”.
boardSent: Your score is saved: you are number {n} this week.
boardTop: Your score is saved (you are not among the top ones yet).
boardOff: The ranking is not available right now.
boardPrivacy: Only the nickname and the score are kept, for up to 4 weeks. No address is stored.
muted: You cannot appear on the ranking for now.
already: Your score for today is already saved.
pseudo_taken: This nickname is already taken. Try another one, for example Fox2001.
pseudo_short: This nickname is too short. Use at least 3 characters.
pseudo_long: This nickname is too long. Use 20 characters at most.
pseudo_chars: Use only letters, numbers, spaces and hyphens.
pseudo_banned: This nickname is not allowed. Please choose another one.
confirmUnpublish: Take this question out of the game? It becomes a draft again.
confirmUseToday: Change today's question? People who already played saw the other one.
confirmDeactivate: Remove all the questions of this pack, even the ones you edited?
confirmRemoveRow: Remove this person from this week's ranking?
confirmRestart: Start a new round? Every question may come back from tomorrow.
startHelp: Pick a starting point in one click. You can change everything afterwards: edit, add or remove questions.
bannerNone: No question is ready: the game is empty for visitors. Add a question or turn on a pack.
bannerLow: Only {count} day(s) of questions left. Add more so the game goes on without repeats.
daysLeft: There are **{count} days** of upcoming questions without repeats ({mode}). After that, the questions come back.
daysLeftNoWrap: There are **{count} days** of planned questions. After that, there will be nothing to play.
noteRepeat: the round starts again: this question already came up
nextHelp: This schedule is a forecast: the choice for a day is fixed at the first visit of that day.
orderHelp: Questions come up in this order, one a day. Move a question with the buttons.
okFirst: This question is already the first.
okLast: This question is already the last.
previewHelp: This is what visitors will see. Only here is the right answer marked ✔: on the site it only appears after answering.
previewEmpty: This question is not complete yet: add the question and at least two answers.
hQuestion: Short and clear, {max} characters at most. Example: Which colour do you get by mixing blue and yellow?
hAnswers: From 2 to 4 answers, {max} characters at most each. Leave the unused ones empty. Example: Green.
fCorrect: Which answer is the right one?
hCorrect: The number of the right answer, the same in every language.
hExplain: Shown after the answer, {max} characters at most. Recommended: it is what makes people want to learn.
hImage: An image uploaded to the site. If you add one, describe it below for people who cannot see it.
hCat: A word or two to sort your questions, {max} characters at most. Example: History.
hDate: To play this question on a specific day (a holiday, an event). Without a date, it joins the rotation. {max} planned days at most.
hState: A draft is not visible and never comes up. Publishing needs the right to publish.
errQuestion: Write the question in {lang}, for example “Which colour do you get by mixing blue and yellow?”.
errTwoAnswers: At least two answers are needed in {lang}, for example “Green” and “Purple”.
errGap: Fill the answers in order: answer {n} is empty in {lang}.
errSame: This answer is the same as answer {n} in {lang}: keep the answers different.
errCount: In {lang} there are {n} answers but {m} in {other}: keep the same number in every language.
errEmpty: Write at least one question with its answers, for example the question and two answers.
errCorrectPick: Pick the right answer: from 1 to 4.
errCorrectRange: The right answer is number {n}, but there are only {count} answers.
errImage: Pick an image uploaded to this site (not an address from another site).
errAlt: Describe the image in {lang} in a few words, for example “A black cat on a keyboard”.
errDate: Write a real date, for example 2026-12-31.
errLevel: Pick a level from the list.
errDateTaken: This date already has a question: “{title}”. Pick another day.
errPast: Pick a date from today onwards.
errPlannedFull: You already have {max} planned days. Remove a date before adding one.
errFull: The bank is full ({max} questions). Delete some before adding more.
errNotFound: This question no longer exists. Go back to the list.
errNotComplete: This question is not complete: it needs the question and at least two answers.
errNoPublishRight: You do not have the right to publish or take down a question. Keep “Draft”.
errPackType: This pack does not fit the game type chosen in the settings.
okPublished: Published: the question joins the game.
okUnpublished: Taken down: the question is a draft again.
okDateCleared: Date removed: the question joins the rotation.
okRestart: A new round begins: questions may come back.
searchHelp: A word from the question, an answer or the category.
plannedHelp: These questions come up on the planned date, before the rotation.
boardAdminHelp: Nicknames are chosen by visitors. Remove a row that is not suitable; to block a person, use the moderation of the participation tool.
boardAdminNone: Nobody is on the ranking yet this week.
boardMissing: The ranking is on, but a tool to manage nicknames is missing. Without it, no ranking is shown.
suggestReason: manages nicknames and participation, for the weekly ranking
packsHelp: Ready-made questions in French and English, published in one click. Once turned on, a pack is edited like your own questions.
okPackAlready: This pack is already fully turned on.
okTemplate: Done: {count} questions are ready and published.
okTemplateEmpty: Done: you start from an empty page. Add your first question.
importHelp: A CSV file (spreadsheet) with one row per question. Columns: question, answer1 to answer4 (answers), correct (number of the right answer), explanation, category, difficulty (easy, medium, hard), date, status, image. For a specific language, add it to the name: question_en. French names (réponse 1, bonne réponse…) work too. Up to {max} questions; if a single row is wrong, nothing is imported and the message says which one. Download the sample file to get started.
hFile: A .csv file of 1 MB at most, saved from your spreadsheet.
fImportLang: Language of columns without a language in their name
hImportLang: For example for a plain “question” column.
optImportDraft: Keep as drafts to read them first
hImportState: A “status” column in the file has the last word.
exportHelp: Download all your questions in a file any spreadsheet can open: to keep them safe or rework them.
restartHelp: Forgets the questions already played: all of them may come back from tomorrow. Useful after fixing many questions.
csvEmpty: The file is empty. Pick a CSV file with a header row, then one row per question.
csvBig: The file is too big (1 MB at most).
csvQuote: A quote is not closed at the end of the file. Check the last question.
csvNoColumn: I cannot find a “{column}” column. The first row must contain the column names, for example {example}.
csvTooMany: The file has too many rows ({max} questions at most).
csvTwoAnswers: At least two non-empty answers are needed in {lang} (columns answer1 and answer2).
csvCount: The number of answers is not the same in every language.
csvCorrect: The right answer (column correct) must be a number from 1 to {count}, a letter or the exact text of an answer.
csvLevel: Unknown difficulty “{value}”: use easy, medium or hard (or facile, moyen, difficile).
csvDate: Unreadable date “{value}”: write it like 2026-12-31 or 31/12/2026.
csvPast: The date {value} is in the past: pick a date from today onwards.
csvStatus: Unknown state “{value}”: use published or draft (or publié, brouillon).
csvDateTaken: The date {value} is already taken by another question.
csvPlannedFull: Too many planned days ({max} at most).
csvFull: The bank would be full ({max} questions at most).
csvNothing: Nothing was imported: fix the file, then try again.
sampleQ1: Which colour do you get by mixing blue and yellow?
sampleQ2: How many days are there in a week?
